nodes.title: SG-4.1 · Serve player contribution history at /api/v1/player/me/contributions
nodes.body:
Context: backend/internal/server/server.go registers ch.Mine at GET /api/v1/contributions/mine. Desired behavior: the same handler is served at GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions. Expected result: the new path returns the caller history and the old path no longer routes to Mine. Why: the player API surface groups player-scoped data under /player/me.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a valid session cookie and round_id, when GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions is requested, then the response is 200 with a JSON array
- Given a valid session cookie, when GET /api/v1/contributions/mine is requested, then it no longer reaches Mine and responds 404
- Given no session cookie, when GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions is requested, then the response is 401


## Scope
- In scope: Route registration in server.New
- In scope: Unit test for the new path in server_test.go
- Out of scope: Changing contribution.Handler.Mine behavior
- Out of scope: Frontend changes
- Preserve: POST /api/v1/contributions
- Preserve: GET /api/v1/contributions/{id}
- Preserve: GET /api/v1/player/me


## Technical constraints
- Go chi router; reuse existing Handler.Mine


## Definition of done
- New path served and old Mine route removed
- Unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Player contribution history is routed at GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions
nodes.body:
Context: server.New registers r.Get("/api/v1/contributions/mine", ch.Mine) at line 77. Desired behavior: register ch.Mine at /api/v1/player/me/contributions and remove the legacy registration. Expected result: the legacy path falls through to /contributions/{id} and responds 404 for the unknown id "mine". Why: consistent player-scoped API.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a session cookie and round_id, when GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions is called, then status is 200 and body is a JSON array
- Given a session cookie, when GET /api/v1/contributions/mine is called, then status is 404
- Given no cookie, when GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions is called, then status is 401


## Scope
- In scope: backend/internal/server/server.go route registration
- Out of scope: Handler logic
- Preserve: Other routes


## Technical constraints
- Route must be registered after ch is constructed


## Definition of done
- Route moved


## Clarifying questions
- None
